text:
maria (eng-infra): Onboarding request for new tenant 'Skyline' — they need p5 + g5 capacity in eu-west-4 and ap-south-1. Can someone pick this up? We need instance increases, ENI bumps, EBS throughput, and placement-group permissions. ETA: ~2 weeks.

sam (eng-infra): I'll own this. Can you paste the account ID and expected concurrency?

maria (eng-infra): Account: 123456789012. Expected steady concurrency: 6 p5s (long-running inference workers), peak 12 p5s, and 20 g5s for high-throughput inference. Sequence lengths mostly 2k. Primary region eu-west-4, ap-south-1 as DR.

sam (eng-infra): Ok creating AWS support case and service-quotas requests now. I'll include ENI and EBS asks.

sam (eng-infra): aws-support-bot: Created case 2548963211 for eu-west-4 p5/g5 quota increase. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=2548963211 :thumbsup:

raj (networking): Heads-up — we saw ENI exhaustion in ap-south-1 on a previous tenant because of dense pod placement. Please request higher ENI per VPC and higher per-subnet limits. Requesting target ENI per VPC 1500.

sam (eng-infra): Noted. Also including EBS gp3 throughput and IOPS increases and asking for placement-group allowance for p5 family. Adding a short justification doc.

sam (eng-infra): Snippet I used to open the case: 
```
aws support create-case --service-code ec2 --category-code limits --severity-code low --subject "Increase p5/g5 quota eu-west-4 for acct 123456789012" --communication-body "Requesting 12 p5, 20 g5, ENI 1500, gp3 throughput 4000Mbps; placement group for p5 required" --region eu-west-1
```

linda (finance): Quick cost note: at steady state expected monthly infra spend ~ $72k (both regions). I'll file a finance ticket for the commit/forecast.

sam (eng-infra): Also opening Service Quotas console tickets for record: 
- p5 family: 12 -> 30
- g5 family: 20 -> 40
- ENI per VPC: 600 -> 1500
- EBS throughput quota: 1000 -> 4000 Mbps

aws-support-bot: Case 2548963211 updated — vendor replied asking for architecture diagram and expected sustained vCPU.

maria (eng-infra): Pushed a short architecture doc (internal): https://rwd.company/docs/skyline-onboard — includes expected vCPU, placement group need, and subnet design.

sam (eng-infra): Replied to AWS with justification and attached the doc. Confirmed we need cluster placement groups for p5 to avoid noisy-neighbor jitter.

eng-infra-bot: terraform apply finished for skyline-vpc (plan: +3 subnets, +1 route table, updated NACLs).

raj (networking): Once quotas land I'll run smoke validations: create 2 placement-groups, spin p5 + g5 instances, measure ENI usage, verify SG rules. I'll also check route table and NAT capacity.

maria (eng-infra): AWS said processing time ~3-5 business days once justification is accepted. Putting this on the onboarding checklist and blocking tenant activation until quotas approved.

linda (finance): Added cost estimate to finance ticket FT-4821. Also flagged potential for reserved instance conversation if Skyline commits.

sam (eng-infra): Marking as in-progress. I'll update this thread for status changes and case numbers.

aws-support-bot: Case 2548963211 status: Pending - Awaiting internal approval.

maria (eng-infra): Thanks team. @sam please @ me when quotas are approved so we can schedule capacity tests and readiness window."
